About us

Abayat by Basma began with a simple idea: modest dress should feel considered as well as look it. Each abaya starts with a clean line and a fabric chosen for how it falls. We keep the detailing quiet so the cut does the talking, and every piece is made to your measurements.

  2. Enter your measurementsFill in each measurement in inches. Check them twice.
  3. Confirm with paymentYour order is confirmed once the advance payment is received.
  4. We make itYour abaya is cut and finished to your measurements.
  5. DeliveryYour abaya is delivered to your address in the UAE.

FAQ

How do I order?

Press Order on any abaya, fill in your details and measurements and submit the form. We then confirm your order and payment details.

Can I design my own abaya?

Yes. Send us a photo, a sketch or an idea, even a design made with an AI tool, and choose your fabric, colours and details. We confirm the design, size and price with you before we start.

How do I take my measurements?

Measure in inches over light clothing. The form lists each measurement we need. If you are unsure, add a note and we will guide you before making anything.

When is my order confirmed?

An order is confirmed after the advance payment is received.

Can I change my order?

You can change an order before it goes into production. Contact us as soon as possible.

How long does delivery take?

Each piece is made to order. We give you an estimated date when we confirm your order.

Can I return or exchange?

Because every abaya is made to your measurements, returns and exchanges are not available. Please check your measurements carefully before submitting.

Order policy

Made to measure

Every abaya is made to the measurements you send, in inches.

Payment

Advance payment is required to confirm your order. We send the payment details after you submit the form.

Measurements

Please double-check every measurement before sending. We make the piece exactly as submitted.

Returns and exchanges

No returns or exchanges, as each piece is made to order.

Delivery

We deliver across the UAE to the address you provide.

Changes and cancellations

Changes are possible before production starts. Once production begins, the order is final.

Contact

Questions before you order? Reach out and we will help.
